description: Needs student-ok (confirm:true OR elicitation) after the student asked to read this message. Opening it marks it read in ADAM, exactly as opening it in a browser does; this is not undone. Returns the body as untrusted text plus sender/recipient display names (emails redacted) and attachment names/sizes only — attachments are never downloaded. Pass folderId and mailId exactly as one adam_list_mail row gives them. Does not send, reply, move or delete. Confirm contract: pass confirm:true OR approve elicitation; hosts without elicitation require confirm:true; decline/cancel → same confirmation_required, no data; forum needs gate only with threadId. Recipe: {"folderId":"...","mailId":"...","confirm":true}.

confirm.description: Optional gate. Set true only after the student asked to read their ADAM mail. Mail is personal correspondence and untrusted. Confirm contract: pass confirm:true OR approve elicitation; hosts without elicitation require confirm:true; decline/cancel → same confirmation_required, no data; forum needs gate only with threadId. Recipe: {"confirm":true}. Opening a message marks it read in ADAM, as opening it in a browser does.

folderId.description: folderId from the same adam_list_mail row

name: adam_read_mail

attachments.description: Names and sizes only; attachments are never downloaded

recipients.description: Display names; email addresses are redacted

sender.description: Display name; email addresses are redacted

title: Read one ADAM mail message
